notes: KG class computed locally from ERA5 monthly reanalysis data bundled with each site's FLUXNET Shuttle download (dataset='ERA5' rows in the DuckDB monthly table), following the Beck et al. classification rule cascade applied to a 1991-2020 monthly T/P normal (matches Beck et al. 2023's own present-day window). Requires >= 20 valid years of the 30; site-years with computed annual P_ERA total > 5000 mm/yr excluded as reanalysis spatial-averaging artifacts (docs/known_issues.md §9a). badm_kg_class/beck2023_kg_class are retained comparison columns only, not used for classification. Scope: current 767-site Shuttle network only — historical-network comparisons and the global land-area backdrop remain Beck-2023-raster-based.
